craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 31. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 10. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: From being in an eligible body, in humanity — but bodied, not then liberated; from body, at end of body, but should go to Śiva.
l4.sanskrit_cite: adhikāriśarīratvānmānuṣye tu śarīragaḥ na tadā mucyate dehāddehānte tu śivaṃ vrajet
